text:
Type: industrial coffee table with shelf
Use: holding drinks, books and magazines in front of a sofa; living room
Style: industrial, rustic
Materials: solid wood top and lower shelf, black steel frame
Colors: warm reddish brown wood, black
Shape: rectangular plank top, open lower shelf, angled black steel legs with X-cross bracing on the sides, medium size, sturdy but open
Feel: warm, rugged, casual
Goes with: leather sofas, exposed brick, black metal accents, Edison lamps; industrial or rustic living rooms

product.name: Phoenix Home Rustic Industrial Solid Wood and Steel Open Shelf Coffee Table, Brown
product.description: Rustic coffee table combines dark hardwood and steel for ultimate strength and a beautiful heirloom-quality aesthetic Planked top and open shelf made of distressed, solid wood with visible natural knots and grain in a warm tone Solid-steel legs with a dark patina and set at a slight angle; X-shaped bracing with exposed metal fasteners and rivets Industrial style mixes materials for edgy, eye-catching results Measures 48 by 24 by 18 inches (LxWxH); 10-inch height between top and open shelf
